paper.title: Middo: Model-Informed Dynamic Data Optimization for Enhanced LLM Fine-Tuning via Closed-Loop Learning
paper.central_claim: Middo is a closed-loop framework that, each iteration, uses the fine-tuned model own loss patterns, embedding-neighbour sparsity and self-alignment scores to flag suboptimal SFT samples, has an LLM rewrite or extend them, and re-fine-tunes the base model on the refined dataset; it reports +7.15% average accuracy on LLaMA-3.1-8B (Alpaca) at constant dataset scale.

provenance.notes: actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref are not exposed to the worker inside this dispatch; model_type is the claude-kimi type overlay assigned by the controller (agent_model=haiku -> claude-sonnet-5-5[1m]).

evidence.quote: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) Large Language Models (LLMs) fundamentally rely on high-quality training data.
The refined dataset immediately feeds back into model training, creating a dynamic feedback loop where improved model capabilities inform subsequent optimization cycles.
evidence.support_explanation: The loop is dataset refinement -> weight fine-tuning -> diagnostics from the updated weights.

evidence.quote: the base model is fine-tuned for one epoch on the dataset optimized in that specific iteration
evidence.support_explanation: Each iteration is a base-model SFT run; the evaluated artifact is the fine-tuned weights.

evidence.quote: We can see that Middo consistently enhances model performance across all benchmarks, achieving an average accuracy increase of
evidence.support_explanation: Claimed effect is benchmark accuracy of fine-tuned LLaMA-3.1-8B / Mistral-7B.

evidence.quote: Middo relies on the model being fine-tuned itself for identifying data quality and complexity.
evidence.support_explanation: Diagnostic signals come from the weights under training; no agent harness component (prompt/skill/tool/workflow/memory/evaluator) is retained or reused.

signatures.object: Instruction-tuning dataset (Alpaca, Alpaca-4o-mini, WizardLM; about 52-70k pairs) whose flagged samples are rewritten by GPT-4o-mini.
signatures.information: Per-sample loss before/after training, embedding k-NN cosine similarity from the previous-iteration model, model self-alignment scores.
signatures.operation: Flag hard / sparse / low-quality samples by dynamic thresholds, rewrite or extend them with an LLM, replace or append, then fine-tune the base model on the refined set for one epoch; repeat three iterations.
signatures.output: Refined SFT dataset and the SFT-ed model weights.
signatures.conditions: Requires a sufficiently capable base model.
signatures.selection_rule: mu + m*sigma thresholds per signal; no held-out acceptance test per edit.
signatures.persistence: Refined dataset across iterations (training data only).
signatures.later_use: Consumed only by the next weight-update run.
signatures.claimed_effect: Average accuracy gain across eight benchmarks after three iterations.
signatures.failure_boundary: Performance declines after the third iteration; scalability and bias noted.

This is data-centric weight training (closest to self-distillation / iterative fine-tuning), which EVIDENCE.md excludes.
